title: Sharks Are Older Than Trees 🦈 #Shorts
script: Sharks are older than trees. Shark ancestors were swimming in Earth's oceans more than 400 million years ago, while the first tree-like forests appeared later. That means sharks were already part of marine ecosystems long before familiar forests covered the land. Their evolutionary history stretches across multiple mass extinctions and enormous changes to our planet.

scenes.sub: Their history goes back over 400 million years.
Early sharks existed before the first tree-like forests.
Their lineage crossed huge planetary changes.
Shark ancestors survived multiple extinction events.
Ocean history is written in their evolution.
